explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/136 with its resolution f(n) ~ (5/6)n (Bennett–Cushman–Dudek–Prałat, Joos–Mubayi). f(n) is the least number of colours in an edge colouring of K_n in which every K₄ (an embedding Fin 4 ↪ Fin n, with the colouring pulled back to its 6 edges) sees at least 5 distinct colours. The open-ended 'determine f(n)' is encoded as f(n)/n → 5/6, which is the known answer.
